follow-up time: Five time points from birth through adolescence
outcome: Epigenetic age acceleration (AA), calculated from DNA methylation profiles
cohort: 1018 mother-child pairs from the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children
finding: Epigenetic age acceleration in children is associated with several factors including sex, birth weight, birth by Cesarean section, and various maternal characteristics during pregnancy such as smoking, weight, BMI, selenium and cholesterol levels.
mod_finding: Birth by Cesarean section was associated with epigenetic age acceleration in children.
